messages:
sophie (partnerships): Quick sync — AcceleratorCorp granted us alpha access under NDA. Need to align on bench plan, deliverables, and feedback loop. Can people chime in on who owns what?

mia (solutions): Nice! Do we have the driver/container artifacts yet?

kevin (hw-partner): Sending driver bundle and sample images to the secure share now. Note: encrypt_and_upload to the NDA bucket, do not mirror.

helen (legal): Reminder: data sharing is restricted — no customer data on the devices, instrumentation logs must be scrubbed. I'll post the redline once I confirm. :white_check_mark:

raj (eng-runtime): We have a perf harness ready but need the device docker image + kernel modules to validate. What model checkpoints should we test? seq lengths?

luis (bench): Proposed minimal matrix:
- models: gpt-small, t5-base, llama-7b (fp16 + int8)
- seq: 128, 512, 1024
- batch: 1, 8, 32
- modes: single-stream (latency) + throughput
We can run a quick baseline and share dashboards.

sophie (partnerships): Good start. Add cold-start numbers and KV cache warm vs cold. Also want memory pressure / OOM logs.

raj (eng-runtime): Can someone confirm whether we can get 2x identical units for cross-validation? We need a small cluster to test autoscaling and eviction behavior.

kevin (hw-partner): We can ship two alpha boards. Shipping ETA 5 business days. Will include serial numbers and firmware v0.9.0.

mia (solutions): For the feedback loop, propose weekly 30min sync + shared Notion page for issues. Also can we get a small set of vendor-provided prompts for accuracy/quality checks?

kevin (hw-partner): Yes, will include a labeled eval set (50 prompts) — embargoed under NDA.

luis (bench): I'll draft the bench runbook. Quick pseudo-command for the harness so infra knows what to expect:
```
./run_bench.sh --model t5-base --seq 512 --batch 8 --mode throughput --duration 300
```
I'll add KPIs: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem, driver counters.

helen (legal): Also flag: telemetry we collect must be opt-in for alpha customers. No stack traces with user payloads.

ops-bot: Created ticket PART-7182 (AcceleratorCorp alpha bench + NDA artifacts). Assignees: luis, raj, sophie.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll provision a test cluster in the dev VPC and share ssh keys. Need the encrypted image location.

kevin (hw-partner): Uploaded to s3://accelerator-alpha/ndashare/ (credentials sent via 1Password).

mia (solutions): I'll prepare a short integration guide for SREs and customer engineers — aim to hand off by next Tue.

sophie (partnerships): Timeline proposal: week 0 — driver + images arrive; week 1 — baseline bench; week 2 — targeted perf tuning; week 3 — joint write-up and go/no-go for broader preview. Thoughts?

luis (bench): Sounds realistic. We may need extra time if kernel tweaks are required (add +1 week contingency).

helen (legal): I'll finalize the NDA redline today and add the telemetry clause.

kevin (hw-partner): Ping me if you need an engineering contact on our side during the tuning runs.

mia (solutions): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the notional agenda for the first sync and add it to the PART-7182 ticket.

sophie (partnerships): Great. Action items: luis = runbook + baseline, raj = infra provisioning, helen = finalize NDA, mia = integration guide, kevin = confirm shipments + eval set. We'll circle up Friday for status. :calendar:
